changes.change: Preserve retrieved evidence and source links when the outer direct-provider fallback task fails after composition timeout. Keep failed task state and primary API error, and disclose incomplete synthesis.
Use shared typed streamflow renderer. Convert ft3/s to m3/s arithmetically and display measurement, timestamp, site identity and provisional flag without model reinterpretation.

Request hard movie trivia for film enthusiasts, validate requested difficulty, translate question/choices using existing MyMemory provider without sending the answer marker. Honor selected response language; on translation failure disclose incompleteness without foreign question dump or correct-answer leak.

For current Southeast Asia requests require open status and observations within 30 days, excluding closed/stale/future records. Show latest and first observation dates, excluded count, source links and bounded meaning of current candidates.

After opinion API authentication failure, fetch same-host public opinion URL and extract only its opinion-content container, ignoring navigation/scripts. Record body source and render bounded body or search snippet with explicit missing-body caveats.

limits: The existing isolated GUI app was kept open; it is the previous E2E build, not a restarted application containing these changes.
Provider availability, translation quality and public CourtListener page body extraction require real GUI retest. A source fix is not a new PASS verdict.
EONET open registration and recent observation are candidate evidence, not proof of continuing harm or exact physical onset.
